neighbours.label: ' example' or ' instance' after 'For', introducing an illustration (For example, ...)
fire: Some programs help rural pupils. For example, in Peru, a radio course reached many villages.
New rules changed the trade. For example, importers now file online.
The design has real limits. For instance, it cannot carry heavy loads.
Their budget is tight (Hall, 2016). For instance, the main cost is rent.
Many birds migrate at night. For example, thrushes fly in the dark.
Language shapes habits. For example, some tongues have no future tense.
Old houses can be costly. For instance, wiring may need replacing.
Prices vary by region. For example, rent is higher near the coast.
